source_excerpt: Shah Rukh Khan and his wife Gauri Khan with children AbRam Khan, Suhana Khan and AbRam Khan attended a Taekwando event in the city. Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan were also seen arriving for the competition with their elder son Taimur Ali Khan. Meanwhile, Karisma Kapoor with her son and actor Nikhil Dwivedi with his wife and son were also present at the event. SRK stepped out of his vehicle and walked towards the venue quickly. The actor was seen wearing a brownish-maroon t-shirt teamed with black pants and a cap. Gauri, Suhana and AbRam were sporting white t-shirts for the event. Kareena and Saif were clicked by the shutterbugs as they twinned in blue shirts and denim while Taimur was in the Taekwondo outfit.
